title: Best AI Mobile App Builder for Indie Founders in 2026
summary: We scored seven AI mobile app builders on the eight things that matter to a solo founder shipping a first app: a build on your phone in minutes, store submission without a Mac, a paywall that converts, and code you own.
body_markdown: RevenueCat's 2026 data found hard paywalls converted 10.7% of downloads to paid by day 35, against 2.1% for freemium, with nearly identical year-one retention. Freemium still fits apps where free users drive word of mouth. Blink sets up either through RevenueCat.
